chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang's Power Revealed — Danyangzi's Immortality Was His Fault
chapter_meta_description: Zhuge Yuan reveals the truth: Li Huowang's Heart-Element power helped Danyangzi become a demigod. Can he learn to control the ability to 'cultivate the false into the true'?
og_title: The One Where Li Huowang Accidentally Makes an Immortal
og_description: A quiet bamboo lodge, a cup of tea, and the most horrifying revelation yet: Li Huowang’s reality-bending power was active all along.
twitter_title: Li Huowang Just Learned His Worst Enemy’s Victory Was His Own Fault
twitter_description: The Heart-Element’s power is real, and Li Huowang used it without knowing—to make Danyangzi an immortal. Chapter 395 is a devastating lore drop.

lore_anchors.definition: The foundational philosophical path for Heart-Elements; the power to *make* a falsehood real through sheer belief or proximity to obsession.
The Zuowandao’s opposing philosophy; the power to *unmake* reality by injecting lies into the fabric of truth.
A being that has partially transcended mortality; not a true immortal but a liminal creature that exists between human and divine.
A consuming, singular fixation powerful enough to hijack supernatural forces; in this world, it acts as a fuel or catalyst for reality-bending.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Did Li Huowang know he helped Danyangzi become an immortal?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No. Danyangzi’s half-face, still alive inside Li Huowang’s body, unconsciously borrowed the Heart-Element’s power to fulfill its obsession with achieving immortality.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the "cultivate the true" method described in this chapter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Only that it exists. Zhuge Yuan has seen it mentioned in a book once but does not know where the full text can be found, leaving Li Huowang with a frustrating lead.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the "North Wind" Zhuge Yuan mentions?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Another Heart-Element (心素) that Li Huowang was previously seeking out as a potential source of help or answers. It is part of the original plan now supplemented by the idea of mastering his own power.
